scope: New small controls only; completed X0 fixtures are development contact, never independent certification.
positive_pass: For each literal CoreProgram.generate output, at every q from zero to fixture q, exactly one block has A membership and exactly one has C membership; actual original partitionCheck and pairwiseEmbeddings pass. Test X0 B-sector colors and per-label arbitrary B colors.

negative_controls.source_overlap: Completed outscope fixture must fail actual original pairwiseEmbeddings and produce exactly two split-A full-budget outputs under sector B colors.
negative_controls.repeated_labels: Actual generate refuses duplicate original label; original partitionCheck must reject duplicated source label multiplicity.
negative_controls.q0: Proper nonmonochromatic three-parent case emits no q0 output.
negative_controls.whole_tag_locality: Exact taggedColor A B constant0 constant0 constant0 gives parent tags 0/1/2, while the false all-global-zero substitution merges the three parents and fails kept A/C.
negative_controls.all_output_completeness: The crossed parity source singleton refinement is proper, source-disjoint and monochromatic but is absent from literal outputs; false every-valid-partition-is-emitted claim must fail.
negative_controls.comparator_corruption: Delete A label from a clean output copy; kept detector must reject while clean twin passes.

execution: Wrapper Python first for pilot, then fresh isolated Lean calls from pinned original sources. No colored census or large raw data.
